reviewer_approval.evidence: The initial complete staged review found two Important signal-state defects. Focused follow-up review verified that external forwarding preserves the deadline and that -k 0 disables SIGKILL escalation while retaining SIGCONT delivery, then reported zero Critical and zero Important findings and approved the two-block packed-root exception. Adminbox occupies 25 packed blocks, retains 116496 process-window bytes before stack use and leaves 287 free root blocks; multicall composition saves eight blocks against standalone timeout. Focused host and cross gates rejected 15 behavioral mutations, passed 14 setpgid checks and measured 128-byte main and 168-byte pre-fork static frames. Renode, physical-board, whole-program runtime-memory, exhaustive signal-race and complete-conformance residuals remain open.
